name: Tap Score PFAS Drinking Water Test
description: Professional PFAS Test for Drinking Water | Certified Tap Score Home Kit | Mail-in Lab Analysis | Easy Sampling, Shipping Included | EPA Testing Method
features: BEST WATER TEST: Tap Score is fast, accurate and easy. Tap Score laboratory test kits are utilized by millions of American homes and businesses every year.
CERTIFIED LABS: Tap Score’s network of EPA/NELAC/ISO and State Certified Labs provides you the fastest and most accurate results for thousands of contaminants found in drinking water.

TESTS FOR: 18 PFAS compounds including PFOS (Perfluorooctanesulfonic acid), PFOA (Perfluorooctanoic acid), Perfluorohexanesulfonic acid, Perfluoroheptanoic acid, Perfluorononanoic acid, Perfluorobutanesulfonic acid, Perfluoroundecanoic acid, Perfluorododecanoic acid, Perfluorodecanoic acid, Perfluorohexanoic acid, NEtFOSAA, NMeFOSAA, Perfluorotetradecanoic acid, Perfluorotridecanoic acid, GenX, 11-Chloroeicosafluoro-3-oxaundecane-1-sulfonic acid, 9-Chlorohexadecafluoro-3-oxanonane-1-sulfonic acid, and 4,8-Dioxa-3H-perfluorononanoic acid
EPA METHOD: 537.1 detects analytes to concentrations below 2 parts per trillion (PPT)
INCLUDES EVERYTHING: Sterilized and Preserved Water Sampling Vials with Pre-Paid Shipping Label for the Lab
SUPPORT: Award-winning support from PhD scientists and engineers when you need it.
INDEPENDENT: Founded at the University of California in Berkeley, Tap Score is designed to help you test your water and evaluate water quality risks and improvement options.
FAST RESULTS TURNAROUND: Get your report back in 10 business days once the lab receives it for testing.
